description: This file defines the Gitlab OAuth2 Provider class, which extends an abstract provider to handle OAuth2 authentication with Gitlab. It includes methods for constructing URLs, handling scopes, and creating resource owner instances.

classes.name: Gitlab
classes.description: A provider class for handling OAuth2 authentication flow with Gitlab, including URL generation, scope management, and user resource creation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the Gitlab provider, setting the domain if specified in options, then calls parent constructor.

methods.name: getBaseAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for initiating the OAuth authorization flow.

methods.name: getBaseAccessTokenUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for obtaining an access token.

methods.name: getResourceOwnerDetailsUrl
methods.description: Provides the URL to fetch user details using an access token.

methods.name: getDefaultScopes
methods.description: Returns the default OAuth scopes used by Gitlab, which is 'api'.

methods.name: getScopeSeparator
methods.description: Returns the scope separator, which is a space character.

methods.name: checkResponse
methods.description: Checks the HTTP response for errors and throws exceptions if necessary.

methods.name: createResourceOwner
methods.description: Creates and returns a resource owner object from response data and access token.
